title: card.statement_issued (CARD_SYSTEM)
description: One event = one row of credit_card_balance.csv (original column names and values are kept in payload). event_time: 02:00 on day 1 of the month after MONTHS_BALANCE (counted from the submission month).

event_id.description: BLAKE2b-128 of source_table + natural key. Deterministic -> use it for de-duplication.

schema_version.description: SemVer. A MAJOR change -> new topic (.v2).

event_time.description: Business time (simulated, +07:00). 02:00 on day 1 of the month after MONTHS_BALANCE (counted from the submission month).

produced_at.description: Wall-clock time the producer sent the event.

customer_id.description: SK_ID_CURR of the customer; also the Kafka message key.

SK_ID_CURR.description: ID of loan in our sample

MONTHS_BALANCE.description: Month of balance relative to application date (-1 means the freshest balance date)
MONTHS_BALANCE.x-note: time only relative to the application

AMT_BALANCE.description: Balance during the month of previous credit

AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL.description: Credit card limit during the month of the previous credit

AMT_DRAWINGS_ATM_CURRENT.description: Amount drawing at ATM during the month of the previous credit

AMT_DRAWINGS_CURRENT.description: Amount drawing during the month of the previous credit

AMT_DRAWINGS_OTHER_CURRENT.description: Amount of other drawings during the month of the previous credit

AMT_DRAWINGS_POS_CURRENT.description: Amount drawing or buying goods during the month of the previous credit

AMT_INST_MIN_REGULARITY.description: Minimal installment for this month of the previous credit

AMT_PAYMENT_CURRENT.description: How much did the client pay during the month on the previous credit

AMT_PAYMENT_TOTAL_CURRENT.description: How much did the client pay during the month in total on the previous credit

AMT_RECEIVABLE_PRINCIPAL.description: Amount receivable for principal on the previous credit

AMT_RECIVABLE.description: Amount receivable on the previous credit

AMT_TOTAL_RECEIVABLE.description: Total amount receivable on the previous credit

CNT_DRAWINGS_ATM_CURRENT.description: Number of drawings at ATM during this month on the previous credit

CNT_DRAWINGS_CURRENT.description: Number of drawings during this month on the previous credit

CNT_DRAWINGS_OTHER_CURRENT.description: Number of other drawings during this month on the previous credit

CNT_DRAWINGS_POS_CURRENT.description: Number of drawings for goods during this month on the previous credit

CNT_INSTALMENT_MATURE_CUM.description: Number of paid installments on the previous credit

NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS.description: Contract status (active signed,...) on the previous credit

SK_DPD.description: DPD (Days past due) during the month on the previous credit

SK_DPD_DEF.description: DPD (Days past due) during the month with tolerance (debts with low loan amounts are ignored) of the previous credit
